text:
maria: Heads-up — PR #678 (optimize toolkit docs) is failing linkcheck and our Go SDK snippet for KV prefetch is missing. CI: https://ci.redwood/integration/678 :link:

docsbot: build/linkcheck failed on staging/docs — broken links detected:
 - /optkit/quant_profiles -> 404
 - /examples/go/prefetch.go -> 404
 - /optkit/kvcaching -> 404

ash: assigning: @anika can you handle the link fixes? @kevin can you add the short Go snippet? I'll shepherd the PR and coordinate with sam for style review.

anika: on it. I'll grep the repo for mentions and open a follow-up PR for redirects if needed. ETA a few hours.

kevin: small Go snippet for KV prefetch that should render in the examples section:
```go
// examples: simple kv prefetch
import (
    "context"
    "github.com/redwood/optkit"
)

func ExamplePrefetch(ctx context.Context, client *optkit.Client) {
    pre := optkit.NewPrefetcher(client)
    pre.Prefetch(ctx, []string{"user_prompt_prefix"})
}
```
(putting this under /examples/go/prefetch.go)

sam: two quick doc bits: 1) language consistency — we use "quantization profiles" elsewhere, so change any "quant_profiles" slugs/ids to match. 2) add a one-paragraph "When to use" under the batching/caching section (3 bullets max).

anika: quick Q — prefer canonical path to be /optimize/quantization/profiles or /optkit/quantization/profiles? I can add 301 redirects either way.

maria: prefer canonical under /optimize/quantization/profiles (centralized UX). Update internal links to that and create redirects from older slugs.

docsbot: @ash CI re-run queued for PR #678 after branch update (linkcheck + render).

kevin: opened PR kevin/optkit-go-snippet with the example and a tiny render test for docgen. PR #680.

anika: opened PR #681 to patch links and add redirects + a short migration note in the migration guide. cc @maria

ash: added review request to both PRs. @sam can you do a doc style pass on #681 (especially the migration note)? I want the "When to use" list short and actionable.

sam: will take a pass this afternoon, will add the 3-bullet table and fix phrasing. Quick note: prefer imperative voice and avoid passive.

maria: perfect. If CI passes on both PRs, can we merge by EOD? :thumbsup:

anika: merging if linkcheck passes and redirects look good. Thanks team!
